name: Jesse
source:
Your Character is shown to be friendly and trusting, although they can become assertive when others treat them or the people they care about poorly; thus, they are determined to keep things fair. Your Character is hinted at being clever, being characterized as a "Ravenclaw" while they were in college. They are also brave and dedicated to justice given that they spend days searching for [url=/c134904/]Kate[/url] after it becomes clear that Walsh is corrupt and Duffy is incompetent. Your Character is also willing to take risks for others, such as [spoiler]stealing a piece of evidence[/spoiler] rather than Naomi or Flynn so they wouldn't get in trouble.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Your_Character_(Veil_of_Secrets)]Wiki[/url]]
